detail.longDescription: We are happy to announce Black Magic Probe Utility aka bmputil V1.2.0 release! This fixes some issues for Windows users, a metadata issue related to the upcoming V3 hardware release as well as aligning the project CoC to the greater Black Magic Debug project! 🎉 As per usual thank you to everyone who contributed and supports the projects through hardware purchases and donations! 🙂 # rust # opensource # electronics # debugger # jtag # swd # stm32 # hardwarehackers https:// codeberg.org/blackmagic-debug/ bmputil/releases/tag/v1.2.0
